# P15 approve-reachability report: Exec facts judged against the effective (cd-tracked) working directory (TrustedCheckoutExec)

Generated by `GenerateEffectiveCWDP15` (internal/effectpolicy/p15report.go) and pinned by
`TestP15ReportEffectiveCWD`; regenerate with `go test ./internal/effectpolicy -run TestP15ReportEffectiveCWD -update`.
Every cell below evaluates real commands through the real engine (default registry and graph policies), once with the new
`TrustedCheckoutExec` and once with the previous one (`requestCWDPolicies`, which judges the request cwd).

Change under review: an Exec fact (a `go test`, `pn workspace build`, `nix build`, ... node) used to be judged against the REQUEST cwd; it is now judged against the directory
its command runs in after the `cd`s before it, and EVERY directory it may run in must be trusted (a git checkout, a go module, or at/under a `pn-workspace.toml`).
So an approval is GRANTED when a `cd` moves an untrusted request cwd into a trusted directory, and WITHHELD when a `cd` moves a trusted request cwd out of trusted ground.

Producers: 40 Exec producers (`ExecProducerPaths`; one representative valid invocation each), listed under "Producers probed" below.
Directories: `marker dir` is a workforest set under a `pn-workspace.toml` (no git/go marker), `git checkout` is a directory with `.git`, `no marker` has no marker above it.

## Summary

- Cells evaluated: 111 (compound shape x request cwd x cd target).
- Exec facts newly APPROVED: 480 = the sum over cells of (producers approved now and not before).
- Exec facts newly WITHHELD: 680 = the sum over cells of (producers approved before and not now).
- Calculation: 12 cells that newly approve x 40 producers = 480; 17 cells that newly withhold x 40 producers = 680.
- Cells where the 40 producers do not all agree: 0 (every producer is the same exec class, so a mixed cell would be a finding).
- Control facts (no Exec fact, or one the check never reaches) whose verdict moved: 0 of 252 probes.

## Per shape: producers newly approved (+) or withheld (-), per request cwd (rows) and cd target (columns)

Each cell reads `change (verdict now)`. `=` means no producer changed; `**+N**`/`**-N**` is how many of the 40 producers are newly approved / newly withheld; the verdict now is `approved` when every producer approves and `not approved` when none does. A runtime or relative target is probed under the first shape only.
